title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Whale accumulation is accelerating as the Fed hits its rate ceiling, positioning Bitcoin to surge while miners and large holders front-run without further tightening interference. Recent analysis ties this to a cycle reset that pushes long-term holders toward deeper custody rather than exits, strengthening hands through volatility. Self-custody flows off exchanges reinforce Bitcoin's uncensorable control.
